abstract:
PURPOSE: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI) is a highly prevalent, yet modifiable determinant of treatment tolerance in pancreatic cancer (PC). Despite its clinical significance, management remains inconsistent due to a lack of oncology-specific guidelines. This project aimed to establish the first U.S. multidisciplinary consensus to standardize pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy (PERT) dosing, education, and longitudinal management in pancreatic oncology.
METHODS: A mixed-methods design was employed, integrating a parallel literature review, six virtual focus groups with patients and clinicians (n = 28), and a formal modified Delphi process. A multidisciplinary panel of 17 experts, including medical, surgical, and radiation oncologists, advanced practice providers, and oncology dietitians, independently rated and refined draft statements over two iterative rounds. Consensus was defined a priori as ≥ 70% agreement.
RESULTS: The process yielded 15 final Consensus Statements, all achieving ≥ 81% agreement. This manuscript highlights a critical subset of six statements focusing on clinical application (CS 10-15), which achieved 94%-100% consensus. Recommendations define standardized starting doses (48,000-72,000 lipase units per meal), evidence-based titration protocols, multi-level patient education requirements, and strategies to mitigate financial toxicity and pill burden.
CONCLUSION: These consensus statements provide a practical, evidence-based framework to reduce provider inertia and practice variability. Broad implementation of these standards offers a vital opportunity to stabilize nutritional status, improve quality of life, and optimize treatment continuity for patients with PC.

임상 적용을 다룬 6개 핵심 권고안은 94%~100%의 높은 전문가 일치율을 기록했습니다.
도출된 15개 전체 권고안 모두 81% 이상의 합의를 달성하여 근거 중심 표준 관리 지침을 마련했습니다.
summary_ko: 췌장암 환자에서 흔하게 발생하는 췌장 외분비 기능부전(EPI)을 관리하기 위해 미국 최초의 다학제 합의안이 수립되었습니다. 환자와 의료진 포커스 그룹 및 17명의 다학제 전문가가 참여한 델파이 합의 과정을 통해 총 15개의 최종 권고안이 도출되었습니다. 권고안은 식사당 48,000~72,000 리파아제 단위의 표준 시작 용량, 근거 기반 용량 조절법, 환자 교육, 약값 및 복약 부담 완화 전략을 제시했습니다. 이를 통해 임상 현장의 치료 편차를 줄이고 환자의 영양 상태 안정과 삶의 질, 항암 치료 지속성을 개선하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
title: Pancreatic Enzyme Replacement Therapy (PERT) in Pancreatic Cancer: First U.S. Consensus Highlights on Dosing, Management, and Provider Inertia
